literal_meaning: সাদা এবং মাঠের মতো সমতল বা সরল
figurative_meaning_en: Lacking embroidery or decoration, devoid of variety, and ordinary
example_sentences_in_english: His house is completely plain and unadorned.
Life has become utterly ordinary and lacking variety.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of unembellished rural simplicity in Bengali culture.
